request: I edited Dragent's panes skill in ~/.agents/skills so it fits how I work. Get the latest Dragent skills into my other agents, but don't lose my edits.
success: the person's edited SKILL.md and that skill's other files unchanged afterwards; the untouched skills updated; the answer says which skill was left as theirs and why
notes: Boundary case: preserve customized skill resources during an update. Ownership is per file: a skill whose SKILL.md the person changed is theirs as a whole, and turning sharing off and on (teach-other-agents) only replaces files still exactly as Dragent wrote them. The agent must not delete or overwrite the folder by hand to force an update.
